== About ==
The Donut SMP anti-exploit is a custom anti-cheat system designed for the server. It was developed from scratch by [https://www.youtube.com/@pedrojava archivePedro] (lead developer).

== How it works ==
Donut SMP's anti-exploit utilizes [https://wurst.wiki/sign_translation_vulnerability translation exploits] in anvils and signs. The translation exploit primarily targets Meteor Client and other major clients to detect if you have it installed. A large number of Meteor Client users have been reportedly banned because of this. Mods such as Freecam are also detected by it.

It can be bypassed by installing the following mod: https://modrinth.com/mod/exploitpreventer

Meteor client attempted to fix it themselves, but it went horribly wrong, so if you want to use meteor client, you must download both that mod and a modified version of meteor client improved to avoid detection: https://github.com/NikOverflow/meteor-client/releases/tag/fix-sign - Download "meteor-client-1.21.11-local.jar", and put that in your mods folder instead of the default meteor client.

If you have any doubts that this is safe, just know that I've used this method for over 2 months, and NikOverflow is a respected member of the Minecraft hacking community

The anti-exploit also has an "Anti-VPN" system that blocks connections from certain IP ranges and gives an error message "We do not allow connecting from your internet provider." It blocks certain IP ranges owned by Hetzner and other major datacenters (e.g. Datacamp).
